channels.provenance: Signal Finder test 5 2026-08-29 (engine off, ignition on): 0x19 in all 5 press windows, 0x01 in all release windows, 0 baseline changes, 0 extras; flat 0x01 during the accelerator run (data/field/signal-finder/2026-08-29-brakeSwitch.json). Marked insufficient by build 5 only because of undersampling (16 DIDs per pass). Preferred over 0x29/0x500C: same ECU as the rest of the telemetry.; test 7 2026-08-30: engine off 01 -> 1..25 (found 6/6), engine running 0x83 -> 131..155 (found 6/6) — NOT a pure switch: rest value changes with the engine, so a boolean binding on it would read pressed whenever the engine runs; use as a small analog (travel) if ever bound.
